integrity: General claims have direct combinatorial proofs; exact finite independent checks are supplied in verify.py. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only nonerasing generator images of exact length two, over a fixed finite alphabet, are classified; asymptotic denominator restricts to distinct-image maps. Finite computational tests cover ranks at most five and are not an infinite proof.
title: Pseudoforest criterion and exact counts for length-two free-semigroup endomorphisms
